how_opened: Canaccord engagement anchors undated outreach to 18 additional prospects.
who_was_in: 1 Strategic: Company C (entered in round 0); no additional whole-company entrant reported.

how_opened: Synacor directed outreach to 37 prospects; indications requested by September 17.
who_was_in: 13 coded entrants: 2 Financial (Company E, CLP), 1 Strategic (Company H), 10 Unknown unnamed NDA signers. Partial-only Company G excluded; Q2.
bids_received: 2: Company E, CLP. Other-scope: Company G (software and services).
how_it_ended: Ten unnamed signers did not submit; Company E selected; CLP and H excluded on 09/23. H’s 09/22 invitation prevented a deadline exit.

how_opened: Synacor selected Company E, executed LOI/exclusivity, and began definitive negotiation.
bids_received: No new whole-company bid; Company E’s prior $2.00 offer remained under negotiation.
how_it_ended: Exclusivity expired 10/23; outreach reopened 10/27 while E remained in negotiations.

how_opened: Renewed outreach after exclusivity; Company H approached on October 27 (trigger d).
who_was_in: 2: 1 Financial (Company E, continuing); 1 Strategic (Company H, returning).
bids_received: No whole-company bids. Other-scope: Company I (portal and advertising), Company E (35% tender).
how_it_ended: Company E turned partial and exited on 12/14; H continued; whole-company solicitation resumed 12/18–12/21.

how_opened: Renewed solicitation of CLP and H after more than 30 days without reported solicitation (trigger d).
bids_received: 1: CLP. Other-scope: Company G (software and services), Company I (portal and advertising), Company E (35% tender).
how_it_ended: CLP selected for definitive negotiation on 01/06; Company H not invited and exited.
